indicator_name: Derived regional commodity balance: production, exports, imports, apparent use, domestic shipments, tonnes, monthly
description: Производный региональный баланс товаров: производство, экспорт, импорт, видимое потребление, отгрузка на внутренний рынок, тонн
methodology: Built by scripts/fetchers/regional_balance.py from INDUSTRY_PRODUCTION_PHYSICAL_BY_REGION_MONTHLY, INDUSTRY_SHIPMENTS_BY_REGION_MONTHLY and EXPORTS_/IMPORTS_VOLUME_BY_REGION_PRODUCT; January 2020 onward. APPARENT_USE = PROD − EXP + IMP. Not an official statistic: trade is attributed to the region where the trader is registered and stocks are ignored -- compare with SHIP_DOM.
